$description: Tier-4 motion tokens (DMNC-1001) — duration + easing for the three CRT animations (phosphor-warmup, phosphor-energize, blink). Cross-platform / theme-invariant. src/styles/keyframes.css remains the runtime source of truth for the keyframes themselves; these are the canonical timing values that the Foundation Figma 'Motion' collection and the Motion spec page mirror. Values transcribed from the component CSS call sites (e.g. Button.css).

warmup.$description: phosphor-warmup — CRT ignition brightness flicker on hover entry. Matches var(--duration-slow) at the Button call site.

energize.$description: phosphor-energize — brightness flash on press / check.

blink.$description: blink — cursor / indicator blink cycle (paired with the stepped easing).
blink easing — hard step, no interpolation (terminal cursor).
